items.text: Manifest under /app/ with icons, shortcuts, screenshots; manifest test
Service worker controls /app/, offline Home from persisted cache with banner, update never applied during workout
Sign-out wipe (IDB, workout keys, push) and 401 session-ended flow returning to route with outbox intact
Preferences applied: theme without flash, reduce motion, units kg/lb, haptics
Reachability: Notifications, Library, Billing, Messages within 2 taps; Summary Done/Share; badge
Responsive: no horizontal scroll at 360x800, 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768; screenshots
Web Push: config, table, routes, push channel, consent/quiet hours/dedupe/410, fake push service tests, E2E subscription round-trip
Android TWA: twa-manifest + schema test, assetlinks route, android-twa.yml (actionlint), MOBILE-APP.md
Admin console PWA: manifest, shell-only SW, offline page, scope separation E2E
Budgets: precache <= 700 KiB, initial member JS <= 145 KB gzip
Standard gates and pnpm e2e pass
Base path /app/ with placeholder / and legacy root worker retirement
Install UX: beforeinstallprompt, 2nd-session banner, iOS sheet
